How it works

Questions

Is PDFmode really free?

Yes. There’s no sign-up, no ads, no watermark and no daily limit. PDFmode is kept going by people who choose to support it.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

No. Everything happens in your browser, on your own device, so your files never reach a server. The page only downloads its own code when it opens, and counts visits anonymously, never your files or personal details.

Which files can I use?

Markdown (.md), plain text (.txt), Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF and web pages (.html), up to 40 MB each. Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF) go through Images to PDF. Older .doc and .ppt files need to be saved as .docx or .pptx first.

What’s the difference between Auto, Continuous and Pages?

Continuous makes one long page with no page breaks, which is easiest to scroll on a phone. Pages makes regular pages, best for printing. Auto (the default) keeps the pages of Word, PowerPoint and PDF files and runs Markdown and text continuously.

Why won’t Adobe Reader open my continuous PDF?

Adobe Reader can’t open pages longer than 200 inches. Chrome, Edge, Safari and most phone PDF viewers can. If you need Adobe Reader, export with Pages.

Why does my Word or PowerPoint file look a little different?

Microsoft’s fonts can’t be included, so PDFmode uses free fonts with the same letter widths, and lines break where they do in Office. Columns, charts and text wrapped around pictures are simplified. For clean, readable text, switch Formatting to Reading.

Can I edit or copy text from a scanned PDF?

Not the existing words. A scan is a picture of a page, so there’s no text to change or copy, and Convert PDF will say so when you choose Text. You can still add new text, sign, crop, number, split or merge it.

Is a signature from Sign PDF legally binding?

Sign PDF places a picture of your signature on the page, like signing a printout. It isn’t a certified digital signature, so for official documents, check what your school or office accepts.

My download didn’t start. Where’s my file?

Check your Downloads folder (on iPhone: Files › Downloads). If nothing arrived, tap Save again on the success screen. Some in-app browsers, like Messenger’s, can block downloads, so open pdfmode.vercel.app in Chrome or Safari instead.

Can PDFmode open password-protected PDFs?

No. PDFmode tells you when a PDF is protected. Remove the password with the app that made it, then try again.

How can I support PDFmode?

Thank you for asking. You can , follow the maker, or simply share PDFmode with your classmates. A small Support link also appears after you save a file.
